error.title: Footage item missing
error.description:
## Footage item missing
FootageItem `{name}` contains missing `{path}`. Render will not produce any frames and AE will stop react to any integration ### How to repair?
Remove `{name}` or provide missing file.

error.title: Source footage missing
error.description:
## Composition has layers without a usable source
Composition '{comp_name}' has {count} layer(s) that cannot render:
{layers}
After Effects still renders these layers, but the frames come out black, and the published version would be empty.
This usually means the footage was removed from the project, or its file is no longer where the project expects it. Removing a loaded item with *AYON > Manage > Remove* does not remove the layers that used it.
### How to repair?
- Undo the removal in After Effects, or load/import the footage again. - Or delete or replace the affected layers. - Then **refresh** the publisher (circular arrow button) and publish again.
If a layer is listed but is fine in After Effects, ask an admin to update the AYON extension: older versions of the extension cannot report layer sources.

error.title: Footage problems
error.description:
## Composition cannot render
Composition '{comp_name}' has {count} footage problems:
{problems}
### How to repair?
Fix every item listed above:
- provide the file, or remove the footage item, for a missing file; - undo the removal and load the footage again, or delete or replace the affected layers, for a layer without a source.
Then **refresh** the publisher (circular arrow button) and publish again.
